template:
Promotional social media graphic, aspect ratio {{aspect_ratio}}.

MAIN VISUAL: {{visual}}, occupying the lower two thirds, photographic, bright natural light.
PRIMARY TEXT: "{{headline}}", large bold geometric sans-serif, top-center, high contrast against the background, generous letter spacing.
SECONDARY TEXT: "{{cta}}", roughly one third the size of the primary text, directly below it, same typeface in regular weight.
LAYOUT: clear hierarchy, text never overlaps the main visual, safe margin of at least 8% on every edge, clean negative space behind the text.
COLOR PALETTE: {{palette}}; use the darkest palette color for text if contrast requires it.
TYPOGRAPHY RULES: render both text blocks exactly as written, correct spelling, no extra words, no garbled or duplicated letters.

Negative: no additional text, no fake logos, no watermark, no people, no clutter, no borders or frames.

example.headline: Summer Sale
example.cta: Up to 40% off, this week only
example.visual: a stack of colorful folded beach towels on white sand
example.palette: coral, sand beige and deep teal
